scientific_integrity: The graph spectrum, W1 Kantorovich duality and coarse curvature derivative relation are credited as prior ingredients. All-time optimal transport norm and sharp amplification transition are argued directly. No assertion of independent mathematical validation, historical exhaustiveness, or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only graphs with r>=2 equal-sized nonempty outer cliques joined at a hub, unit-rate unnormalized graph-Laplacian heat flow, shortest-path W1 and finite vertex sets; no extension to heterogeneous/weighted blades, normalized walks, Wp for p!=1, or infinite graphs.
title: Exact Wasserstein heat-flow amplification on equal-blade windmill graphs
